title: Lentsoe Pele ho Sefefo
intro: Motho e mong lehoatateng o ile a ema ho bitsa sechaba se matla hore se khutlele 'neteng. Batho ba ne ba tsebahala ka mehaho ea bona e metle le matla a sa bapisoeng le 'ona. Leha ho le joalo, boikhohomoso ba bona bo ile ba ba foufatsa, 'me ba hana ho mamela. Qetellong, kotlo e bohloko ea ba oela, ea siea sehlopha se senyenyane feela sa balumeli.
clues: Ke ile ka romeloa ho batho ba matla ba neng ba lula libakeng tse sabaletseng 'me ba tsebahala ka matla a bona.
Batho ba ka ba ile ba latela sechaba se seng se seholo se neng se se se timelitsoe.
Ba ne ba e-na le mehaho e metle haholo 'me ba hahile litora tse telele.
Ke ba bitsitse ho rapela Molimo a le Mong, empa ba ile ba hana ho lahla litšoantšo tsa bona.
Kotlo e matla e ile ea ba fihlela, ho sa sala feela ba neng ba lumela le 'na.
Ke 'na ea rometsoeng ho sechaba se matla se tsejoang ka hore ke Aad.

arabic: أَوَعَجِبْتُمْ أَن جَآءَكُمْ ذِكْرٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنكُمْ لِيُنذِرَكُمْ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ إِذْ جَعَلَكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍۢ وَزَادَكُمْ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ بَصْۜطَةًۭ ۖ فَٱذْكُرُوٓا۟ ءَالَآءَ ٱللَّهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verse: Then do you wonder that there has come to you a reminder from your Lord through a man from among you, that he may warn you? And remember when He made you successors after the people of Noah and increased you in stature extensively. So remember the favors of Allāh that you might succeed." (7:69)
